_comment: Element kind classification. Applied by tools/apply-kinds.ts.
Per-competency-area default with named per-element overrides, the same
shape as the ceiling plan, so the judgement is reviewable in one place.
knowledge  can explain, relate and analyse it. Evidence is explanation.
skill      can perform it. Evidence is a work product they produced;
an account of how it would be done cannot substitute.
Description is excluded, not writing — an uncertainty
budget is written and IS the performance. Whether it
happens at a bench is `demonstration`, not `kind`.
judgment   can decide under ambiguity and defend it. Evidence is a
defence, and there is often no single right answer.
Most areas are homogeneous, which is why area defaults carry most of the
work. Overrides are the elements that break their area's pattern —
usually titles beginning Deciding, Defending, Recognising, Choosing,
Expect Phase 2 to refine this: writing an element's anchors is the act
that reveals whether it is really knowledge, skill or judgment, exactly
as it will reveal whether the level ceiling was honest.
Authority is deliberately not a kind here. See docs/00-context.md.
